# Audited third-party license overrides

This directory contains license text only when an exact bundled package version omits a license file from its published package. Release tooling selects overrides by the encoded package name and exact version; it does not use a version range or a generic license template.

## boolbase@1.0.0

- Declared package license: `ISC`
- Published package metadata: `boolbase@1.0.0`, authored by Felix Boehm
- Authoritative source: <https://github.com/fb55/boolbase/blob/be0bcd8a4e917a0a5895e95b523fbbed05a64871/LICENSE>
- Source commit: `be0bcd8a4e917a0a5895e95b523fbbed05a64871` (`Create LICENSE`)
- Local override: `boolbase@1.0.0.txt`

The override text is copied verbatim from the upstream license file. Review this provenance again whenever the bundled boolbase version changes.
